outreach_draft.subject: A thought on your Criminal Law work
outreach_draft.body:
Daniel,

I was looking through Meyer Friedman Reed’s site and noticed the homepage speaks to Family Law, Criminal matters, and Business matters, while Family Law and Personal Injury have their own focused pages. Criminal Law still lives inside the general homepage conversation.

That client is arriving with a very different mindset from someone dealing with a divorce or an injury—questions about charges, immediate risk, what happens next, and how quickly they need counsel.

A focused Criminal Law page could speak directly to that person, give Google a focused page to crawl and index, and give AI tools clearer context around that part of the firm’s work.

I’m using Criminal Law as the first mockup because the contrast with the existing Family Law and Personal Injury pages makes the idea easy to see without changing the firm’s overall positioning.

I’m putting together a quick mockup to show you what I mean. I’ll send it over in the next couple of days.

If you’d rather I didn’t, just let me know.
